mapper.sql: id, product_code, name, category_code, protocol, protocol_document_id, transport, vendor, model, metadata::text as metadata, configuration::text as configuration, connector_count, description, state, created_at, updated_at

where.if: and ( lower(product_code) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or lower(name) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or lower(model) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )

mapper.select: select from pep_domain.product order by id
mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.product (product_code, name, category_code, protocol, protocol_document_id, transport, vendor, model, metadata, configuration, connector_count, description, state, created_at, updated_at) values (#{productCode}, #{name}, #{categoryCode}, #{protocol}, #{protocolDocumentId}, #{transport}, #{vendor}, #{model}, cast(#{metadata} as jsonb), cast(#{configuration} as jsonb), #{connectorCount}, #{description}, #{state}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update pep_domain.product set name = #{name}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, protocol_document_id = #{protocolDocumentId}, transport = #{transport}, vendor = #{vendor}, model = #{model}, metadata = cast(#{metadata} as jsonb), configuration = cast(#{configuration} as jsonb), connector_count = #{connectorCount}, description = #{description}, state = #{state}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
